title: Live at the Fillmore East (March 7, 1970): It's About That Time

drum_performances.name: Jack DeJohnette
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Directions: the cymbal with the bass drum against the snare, and an intro of eighth-note quintuplets, five in a half note (Bishop).

evidence.note: Identified from Bishop's header, 'Live at the Fillmore East'; recorded 7 March 1970, released by Columbia/Legacy in 2001.

drums.description: Electric Miles at full pressure: a churning rock-jazz pulse broken up by constant snare and cymbal commentary.
